corr.text:
Design correction — Lithic is now a native Terraform OS world

The rejected version built a separate OS (slate strip, flex rail, angular panels). This rebuild uses the ACTUAL Botanica OS shell as the source of truth: same warm-paper desktop, menubar, dock, window chrome, tactile buttons, Young Serif / Figtree / JetBrains Mono, and the same pannable world-navigator Botanica uses to move between worlds.

Only the environment and the three destinations are new. Botanica and Orbis are untouched.

reuse.text:
Reused (shared, unchanged) vs new (world-only)

REUSED verbatim: the entire shell stylesheet — menubar, dock, .win window frames/controls, .btn tactile buttons, the .uv pan/zoom navigator + specimen panel, toasts, mascot rig, type scale, 10–12px radii, 1.5px ink borders, keyframes, reduced-motion + mobile rules. Window-manager (geom/drag/focus) and pan/zoom math are the same code.

NEW (environment only): the geological wallpaper (strata, cut geode, mine headframe, ore crystals), the three dig-site bodies on the chart (Foundation / Crystal Matrix / Refinery), the amethyst + copper world accents, and Flint — the Lithic companion — drawn in the same ink-outline style as Sprout.

try.text:
Try it (press Play on the Main board)

The Survey window opens on the Lithic chart. Drag to pan, scroll / use the zoom pad, hover a body for a preview, click one to dock its specimen sheet.

The Foundation (HTML, V2.0) is OPEN and marked “you are here” — “Enter the Foundation” plays a simulated descent (the real HTML academy is Stage 2). The Crystal Matrix (DAX) and The Refinery (Power Query M) are SEALED — preview only, version numbers not dates. “Orbis” (menubar, dock, desktop icon, or the panel) simulates the hand-off back to the hub. Tap Flint for a reading.

scope.text:
Scope

This is the ONE screen asked for: the Lithic universe home, inside the existing OS. No curriculum, no HTML editor, no lesson/mission/recap screens yet.

Reference boards below show the desktop (no window), the Foundation selected, and a sealed-discipline specimen sheet.

Stopping here for approval before Stage 2 (The Foundation — HTML academy).
